searchText: I think that's something that can be avoided by having a fork that intentionally breaks consensus, then either undoes that change or shuts down (automatically) after 1 day, which could be with a 50/50 chance. As far as I can tell the end result of that should be a loss of finality until we get above the 2/3 threshold again due to slashing and/or the automatic undoing of the change. That way the majority chain is pre-destined to loose after some time. Though I don't know how many insights you'd be able to get out of that. Yeah, there's no clear outcomes that we can guarantee with this. I don't even know the real makeup/distributions of Goerli currently, but one of the more useful things coming out of it will be to give all teams an environment, even if temporary, to collect data of performance on a very turbulent environment. If that's something useful at all for teams. we have seen this happening in early devnets for 4844 and surely would be exciting way to sunset goerli infact make a special forking geth release 😆 and let invalid block get finalized on goerli and then release fixed geth and see the chaos unfold (joker from dark knight comes to mind)
